title: Outreach criteria
description: Flags a location for outreach review when an external alert is active and its distance to the nearest service point exceeds a threshold. Missing evidence is concluded unknown rather than negative.
mustNotBeReadAs: A recommendation to visit or not visit anywhere. The threshold is a practitioner judgement, and this ruleset as shipped has no published basis for any particular value.
rules:
# Missing evidence stays unknown. Threshold is illustrative.
{ ?p fw:distanceKnown false. } => { ?p fw:decision fw:Unknown. }.
{ ?p fw:alertKnown false. } => { ?p fw:decision fw:Unknown. }.
{ ?p fw:distanceKm ?d; fw:heatAlert true. ?d math:greaterThan {{threshold}}. } => { ?p fw:decision fw:Review. }.
{ ?p fw:distanceKm ?d; fw:heatAlert true. ?d math:notGreaterThan {{threshold}}. } => { ?p fw:decision fw:NoFlag. }.
{ ?p fw:distanceKnown true; fw:heatAlert false. } => { ?p fw:decision fw:NoFlag. }.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.meaning: Distance above which an alerted location is flagged for review.

inputContract.note: fw:distanceKm welds a unit into a predicate name. It is kept at 1.0.0 because changing it changes the rules and this version must reproduce the shipped conclusions exactly; a unit-free predicate with a declared unit is the 2.0.0 change.

basis.statedBy: The ruleset text itself: "Threshold is illustrative."
basis.note: Declaring this ruleset as data is what exposed that it has no source. The rule set is structurally sound and its threshold is unsourced, and those are different claims that a template literal inside an execution path kept indistinguishable.
